messages:
maria.park: FYI — onboarding HF model (eleutherai/gpt-neox-fork) shows a measurable drop in eval BLEU/QA after HF->Redwood conversion. Repro below.

samir: Did you diff tokenizer outputs vs HF? :thinking_face:

maria.park: yes. token counts differ a lot on prompts with combining marks and weird whitespace. Example I used: 'éclair' (e + COMBINING ACUTE) vs 'éclair' — HF tokenizer.json explicitly had normalizer: 'NFC', our loader applied NFKC by default. Quick snippet:```
# HF baseline
normalizer: NFC
encode('éclair') -> [tokens len 5]
encode('éclair') -> [tokens len 5]

# Redwood converted (current)
applies NFKC in pretokenizer -> some inputs fold differently -> token counts diverge
```

jia.chen: also saw leading-space diffs for chat templates. HF tokenizers often rely on add_prefix_space=true for correct BPE splits when using space-prefixed chat turns. Our conversion lost that in at least one variant, so messages that start with a space tokenized differently.

carlos: that explains the regression spikes after quantization: calibration prompts feed different token ids into KV-cache layout, slight off-by-one in prefix tokens can change attention state and downstream logits. Quantized kernels amplify the change.

tokenizer-bot: unit-tests/tokenizer-roundtrip: FAILED (8 mismatches) — failing examples attached to the run.

maria.park: I put a tiny repro in PR 432 showing both issues (unicode normalizer + add_prefix_space). Also found a byte-fallback mismatch: HF had byte_fallback=true in pretokenizer for some legacy byte-level models; our loader converts unknown bytes to replacement char instead.

samir: proposal: during conversion, copy these keys from tokenizer.json into our model config: normalizer (NFC/NFKC), add_prefix_space, byte_fallback behavior, and special_tokens_map. If missing, run a quick heuristic check to detect combining-mark cases.

jia.chen: +1. Also watch special token spacing — our chat-template generator was trimming spaces around <|user|> and <|assistant|>, which changes tokens when prefix-space is expected.

carlos: short mitigation: add an hf_compat_mode flag in the loader that 1) applies HF normalizer verbatim, 2) preserves add_prefix_space, 3) uses HF byte fallback semantics. We can gate it behind staging runs.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging conversion job triggered for model onboarding (job id: 20240610-214). ETA ~20m.

maria.park: I'll re-run evals with hf_compat_mode and post diffs. For now please don't promote this model to Dedicated until results are stable. :eyes:

samir: I can add a small unit test in ci that compares token ids for a handful of fuzzed strings between HF python tokenizer and our converted tokenizer. If mismatch -> fail conversion.

jia.chen: sounds good. also log example inputs that changed so SRE/customer-facing teams can triage if deployed.

maria.park: thanks — will follow up with PRs: 1) conversion shim, 2) ci check, 3) eval rerun. :thumbsup:

carlos: one more note — embeddings/eval pipelines rely heavily on exact token boundaries for some metrics; please include an embedding-regression check too.

maria.park: noted, adding embedding-diff snapshot to the eval run.
